name: Sim0 GPSR Product Safety Info for WooCommerce
author: joesimo

sections.description:
The EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR), also called Regulation (EU) 2023/988, asks online sellers to show product safety information on each listing. That includes the manufacturer, the EU responsible person when the manufacturer is not established in the EU, a product identifier, and any safety warnings.

Sim0 GPSR Product Safety Info for WooCommerce gives you one place to enter that GPSR information and shows it to shoppers in a Product safety tab on the product page.

Fields

  • Manufacturer name, postal address and electronic contact (email or website)
  • EU responsible person name, postal address and electronic contact
  • Product identifier (type, batch, model or serial number)
  • Warnings and safety information
  • Link to safety instructions or a document, for example a PDF in your media library

Features

  • Store-wide defaults, with per-product overrides on simple products. Grey placeholder text in the product editor shows the default used when a field is left empty.
  • A Product safety tab on the product page, grouped under Manufacturer, EU responsible person and Product identification and safety, only when there is something to show.
  • Email addresses become protected mailto links, websites and documents become links, and addresses keep their line breaks.
  • Works with classic themes and block themes that use the product details block.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks. No tracking, no ads, no external requests. Translation ready.
  • Developer filters: psigpsr_fields, psigpsr_resolved_values, psigpsr_render_html and psigpsr_settings.

Variable, grouped and external products show the store defaults.

How to

  1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Product safety and enter store defaults for the manufacturer, EU responsible person, product identifier and warnings.
  3. To override a simple product, edit it, open the Product safety tab, and fill only the fields that should differ. Empty fields keep the default, shown as grey placeholder text (screenshot 2).
  4. Shoppers see a Product safety tab with those details (screenshot 1). The tab is hidden when every field is empty.
  5. Optional: rename the tab in the settings.
  6. To remove stored values when you delete the plugin, tick “Remove data on uninstall” first.

Important

This plugin helps you display product safety information. It is not legal advice and does not by itself make a store compliant with the GPSR or any other law. Check your obligations with a qualified advisor.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Sim0 GPSR Product Safety Info for WooCommerce”, then install and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Product safety and fill in your store defaults.
  4. To override a value for one simple product, edit the product and open the Product safety tab in the Product data box.
sections.faq:
What is the EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR)?

The GPSR is Regulation (EU) 2023/988, the EU law on the safety of consumer products. For distance sales, Article 19 lists information that an online listing should show, including the manufacturer, the EU responsible person where required, a product identifier, and any warnings or safety information. This plugin has fields for that information. It is not legal advice.

What does GPSR Article 19 ask an online listing to show?

For distance sales, Article 19 of Regulation (EU) 2023/988 lists at least: the manufacturer’s name, postal address and electronic address; the EU responsible person’s name, postal address and electronic address when the manufacturer is not established in the EU; information that identifies the product, including a picture, its type and any other identifier; and any warnings or safety information. The plugin has a field for each of these. The product picture is your normal WooCommerce product image.

Who is the EU responsible person?

An economic operator established in the EU who is responsible for the product under Article 16 of the GPSR, for example an EU manufacturer, importer, authorised representative or fulfilment service provider. If your manufacturer is outside the EU, enter that person in the EU responsible person fields.

I sell into the EU from outside the EU. Can I use this?

Yes. Enter the manufacturer in the manufacturer fields. Enter the person or company established in the EU in the EU responsible person fields.

What counts as an electronic address?

An email address or a contact page where shoppers can reach the manufacturer or responsible person directly. The European Commission’s GPSR guidelines say a website alone is not enough if it does not allow direct contact.

Where are the settings?

WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Product safety.

Where does the information appear for shoppers?

In a Product safety tab next to the Description and Additional information tabs on the single product page. You can rename the tab in the settings.

Why don’t I see the tab on a product?

The tab only appears when at least one field has a value, either on the product or in the store defaults.

Can I set values for each variation of a variable product?

Not in this plugin. Variable products show the store defaults.

Does this make my store GPSR compliant?

No plugin can do that on its own. This plugin helps you collect and display the information. What you need to show depends on your products and your role, so check with a qualified advisor.

Does the plugin send any data anywhere?

No. It makes no external requests and does not track anything. All data stays in your WordPress database.

Is data removed when I delete the plugin?

Only if you tick “Remove data on uninstall” in the settings before deleting the plugin. This protects your data if you delete and reinstall.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • The setup notice now shows only on the Plugins screen and can be dismissed for good.

1.0.3

  • New setup notice after activation: it points to the store details screen and to your newest product, and goes away once you save a store default or dismiss it.
  • The Product safety settings page now says whether the tab is showing yet and links to a product page.
  • Readme: more answers about GPSR Article 19 listing information, plus a clearer short description, tags and first paragraph for GPSR, manufacturer and EU responsible person searches.
  • Removes the per-user dismissal setting on uninstall when “Remove data on uninstall” is ticked.

1.0.2

  • Display name now includes GPSR: Sim0 GPSR Product Safety Info for WooCommerce.
  • Added a screenshot of the store defaults screen.
  • Tested with WooCommerce 11.3.

1.0.1

  • Public name and slug are now Sim0 Product Safety Info for WooCommerce / sim0-product-safety-info-for-woocommerce.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
